sentences.text: The in-force UCB directions do not prohibit pre-payment charges for cases outside the specifically listed categories in paragraph 261(1) and 261(2), because paragraph 261(5) says such charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.
For this case, the floating-rate restrictions in paragraph 261(1) and paragraph 261(2) do not apply.

The product note’s 2% foreclosure charge for non-individual borrowers therefore does not conflict with the cited RBI pre-payment rule set on its face, but it must still be disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and any undisclosed pre-payment charge cannot be charged.

missing.searched: Needed to confirm whether the loan falls within the dated scope of paragraph 261 and whether any other timing-based pre-payment rule applies.
